<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 179.0946, which in positive mode is most likely the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈178.0873 Da. The formula that matches this mass most closely is C₇H₁₄O₅ (exact mass 178.0841 Da, within a few millidaltons of the observed value). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C7H14O5.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H14O5</final_answer>
